msg: I found that by using trial and error I was able to determine colours of gnomes that would get me the most mushrooms. I would use the 1x multiplier rounds to test different colours, then repeatedly list the successful colours over and over in my mind (for example I would say to myself brown, orange, green, purple over and over if they gave me the most mushrooms and with concentration managed to select the better option more often than not). I would use the 5x multiplier rounds to use the list I'd created in my mind in order to receive the most mushrooms. However, bear in mind that this list changes regularly, so using the 1x multiplier levels to test out different colours is crucial. Use the breaks in between to clear your mind, as I found that the successful colours from the previous round rarely stayed successful in the next one. If you get confused and lose track of colours just use the 1x multiplier levels to rebuild the list in your mind. Good luck!
